{{Quote|Hey, just a little worried about losing my ship Tala. That makes this a big deal.|Conevor to Tala|<ref name="Suns of Fortune">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref>}}
'''Conevor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who worked with the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tala (pilot)|Tala]] and the [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] [[Gus (Drall)|Gus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During the war Conevor began slumming on [[Treasure Ship Row/Legends|Treasure Ship Row]], a street in the [[Blue Sector/Legends|Blue Sector]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. Whilst on the Row he began spending time with the [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] known as the [[Silestro Privateers]], and boasted to them of Tala's incredible speed as a pilot, claiming he would bet his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on her in a race. The privateers leader, [[Jostero]], then challenged Tala to a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] race, with Conevor betting on Tala. Whilst waiting at the finish line, he became increasingly nervous as Tala raced, and contacted her by [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] several times throughout much to her annoyance. Shortly before the race finished Gus informed Conevor that no matter the outcome of the race the privateers planned on [[Death/Legends|killing]] the trio and taking their belongings. Tala won the race, but before the privateers could attack the three comrades, a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] belonging to the [[Corellian Security Force]] arrived and both parties involved in the race fled.<ref name="Suns of Fortune" />

==Behind the scenes==
Conevor was first mentioned in a short narrative at the start of ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying system. The book never clarified his [[Species/Legends|species]].
